panels.title: Latest default rate
panels.description: Share of the total credit portfolio (SGS 21082) overdue for more than 90 days in the latest month in range. Colour bands (green < 3%, orange < 4%, red ≥ 4%) are display thresholds, not official ones.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT arg_max(value, ref_dt)::DOUBLE AS default_rate
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_credit_default/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Change vs 12 months earlier
panels.description: Latest default rate in range minus the rate 12 months before it, in percentage points (red = deterioration).

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_credit_default/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
),
l AS (
  SELECT max(ref_dt) AS ref_dt
  FROM d
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT (cur.value - prev.value)::DOUBLE AS yoy_change
FROM l
JOIN d AS cur ON cur.ref_dt = l.ref_dt
JOIN d AS prev ON prev.ref_dt = (l.ref_dt - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE

panels.title: Range low → high
panels.description: Lowest and highest default rate in range, with the month each occurred.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT printf(
  '%.2f%% (%s) → %.2f%% (%s)',
  min(value)::DOUBLE,
  strftime(arg_min(ref_dt, value), '%Y-%m'),
  max(value)::DOUBLE,
  strftime(arg_max(ref_dt, value), '%Y-%m')
) AS range
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_credit_default/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Latest reference month
panels.description: Most recent month with a published value in range; SGS 21082 is published with a ~2 month lag.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT strftime(max(ref_dt), '%Y-%m') AS latest
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_credit_default/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Default rate
panels.description: Monthly share of the total credit portfolio overdue for more than 90 days, with its trailing 12-month average (shown once 12 months are available). Dashed lines mark the 3% and 4% display thresholds.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT
    ref_dt,
    value,
    avg(value) OVER w AS avg_12m,
    count(*) OVER w AS months
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_credit_default/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ref_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 12 MONTH
    AND ref_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
  WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY ref_dt RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 11 MONTH PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT
  ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  value::DOUBLE AS "Default rate",
  CASE WHEN months = 12 THEN avg_12m::DOUBLE END AS "12-month average"
FROM d
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Month-over-month change
panels.description: Default rate minus the previous month's, in percentage points (red = deterioration, green = improvement).

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_credit_default/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
)
SELECT
  cur.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  (cur.value - prev.value)::DOUBLE AS "Monthly change"
FROM d AS cur
JOIN d AS prev ON prev.ref_dt = (cur.ref_dt - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)::DATE
WHERE $__timeFilter(cur.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Year-over-year change
panels.description: Default rate minus the rate 12 months earlier, in percentage points; above zero means the portfolio's credit quality worsened over the year.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_credit_default/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
)
SELECT
  cur.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  (cur.value - prev.value)::DOUBLE AS "Change vs 12 months earlier"
FROM d AS cur
JOIN d AS prev ON prev.ref_dt = (cur.ref_dt - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE
WHERE $__timeFilter(cur.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Yearly summary
panels.description: Average, low, high and end-of-year default rate per calendar year overlapping the range; for the current year end_of_year is the latest published month. change_pp is end_of_year minus the previous year's end_of_year.

targets.rawSql:
WITH y AS (
  SELECT
    year(ref_dt) AS year,
    count(*) AS months,
    avg(value) AS average,
    min(value) AS low,
    max(value) AS high,
    arg_max(value, ref_dt) AS end_of_year
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_credit_default/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  GROUP BY year
),
c AS (
  SELECT *, end_of_year - lag(end_of_year) OVER (ORDER BY year) AS change_pp
  FROM y
)
SELECT
  year::VARCHAR AS year,
  months,
  average::DOUBLE AS average,
  low::DOUBLE AS low,
  high::DOUBLE AS high,
  end_of_year::DOUBLE AS end_of_year,
  change_pp::DOUBLE AS change_pp
FROM c
WHERE c.year BETWEEN year($__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP) AND year($__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY c.year DESC

panels.title: Monthly values
panels.description: Every published month in range with its month-over-month and year-over-year changes in percentage points.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_credit_default/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
)
SELECT
  strftime(cur.ref_dt, '%Y-%m') AS month,
  cur.value::DOUBLE AS default_rate,
  (cur.value - m1.value)::DOUBLE AS mom_change_pp,
  (cur.value - m12.value)::DOUBLE AS yoy_change_pp
FROM d AS cur
LEFT JOIN d AS m1 ON m1.ref_dt = (cur.ref_dt - INTERVAL 1 MONTH)::DATE
LEFT JOIN d AS m12 ON m12.ref_dt = (cur.ref_dt - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)::DATE
WHERE $__timeFilter(cur.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY cur.ref_dt DESC
